findings.evidence: Line 21 docstring `g_R = -Q sin²θ_W`; line 159 `ofQuantumNumbers_gR ... = chiralCoupling 0 q s2`; grep of the file shows `chiralCoupling` lemmas are only `chiralCoupling_def` (76) and `chiralCoupling_zero_zero` (81).
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem chiralCoupling_zero_left (q s2 : ℝ) : chiralCoupling 0 q s2 = -(q * s2)` (and keep `chiralCoupling_zero_zero` as its corollary).
findings.issue: The only evaluation lemma for `chiralCoupling` is the doubly-zero case `chiralCoupling_zero_zero`. The singlet value `chiralCoupling 0 q s2 = -(q * s2)` — stated as a headline formula in the module docstring (line 21, `g_R = -Q sin²θ_W`) and the exact term `ofQuantumNumbers_gR` leaves behind — is never stated, so a consumer computing any concrete right-handed coupling (e.g. the down quark's) is stuck on `chiralCoupling 0 (-1/3) s2` with nothing but `chiralCoupling_def` to fall back on.

findings.evidence: Lines 103/109 `@[simp] gL_add_gR`, `gL_sub_gR` with LHS `c.gL + c.gR`, `c.gL - c.gR`; lines 150/158 `@[simp]` rewrite `(ofQuantumNumbers _ _ _).gL/.gR` to `chiralCoupling _`, destroying that LHS pattern; `chiralCoupling_def` (76) carries no `@[simp]`.
findings.fix: Pick one normal form: either tag `chiralCoupling_def` `@[simp]` (so `chiralCoupling` never blocks an arithmetic goal), or drop `@[simp]` from `ofQuantumNumbers_gL`/`_gR` and keep them as named characterisations; in either case add the `chiralCoupling 0 q s2` lemma above so the chiral side is computable.
findings.issue: Non-confluent `@[simp]` set on `ofQuantumNumbers`: `ofQuantumNumbers_gV` (139) and `_gA` (144) rewrite to raw arithmetic, while `_gL` (150) and `_gR` (158) rewrite to `chiralCoupling`, which no simp lemma unfolds. Since simp rewrites the `.gL`/`.gR` subterms first, the `@[simp]` lemmas `gL_add_gR` (103) and `gL_sub_gR` (109) can never fire on an `ofQuantumNumbers` term: `simp` leaves `chiralCoupling t3 q s2 + chiralCoupling 0 q s2 = t3 - 2*q*s2` unproved. The same mixed-language goal arises downstream via `smTreeLevelCouplings_eq` + `ofQuantumNumbers_gL`.

summary: Surface, exposure and the §0.4 product set are right, but `chiralCoupling` ships without the evaluation lemma its own docstring advertises (`g_R = -Q sin²θ_W`), and the `@[simp]` set is non-confluent: `ofQuantumNumbers_gL/_gR` rewrite into an opaque `chiralCoupling` while `ofQuantumNumbers_gV` rewrites into arithmetic, so `gL_add_gR`/`gL_sub_gR` never fire on `ofQuantumNumbers` terms.
